events.title: 'a Dog’s Dream' Selected for INDIE Live Expo 2026
events.summary: I’m excited to share that a Dog’s Dream has been selected for INDIE Live Expo 2026.4.25 (INDIE Waves)!It’s a strange and quiet dream of an old dog, and it will be featured during the live broadcast. You’ll be able to catch a small glimpse of the game alongside many other indie titles.Watch the live stream:If you’re interested, please consider adding the game to your wishlist — it really helps me a lot.Thank you so much for your support.

events.title: Demo Coming in April – Development Update
events.summary: Hello, everyone waiting for “a DOG*s DREAM.” The two of us are working hard on the game right now. We’re planning to release a demo in April, and you’ll be able to play the full game in June. We’ve been working hard to build up our wishlist count—it's already reached 600, and we’re truly happy and grateful. Recently, we updated the game trailer and created a settings menu for the demo.
